$comment: Guided story tours. Each step either references an event (camera from the event or the step) or sets a year with narration written for this project.

tours.title: Belfast 1798 — The Streets of Revolution
tours.subtitle: From the founding of the United Irishmen to the execution of Henry Joy McCracken

intro.title: Belfast, 1791
intro.text: A town of about 18,000 people gathered around High Street, the quays and a web of narrow entries. Reform clubs, a radical press and Presbyterian congregations made it the cradle of a movement. Markers show documented places in cyan, approximate places in pale gold and unverified traditions as amber triangles; the shaded discs show how far each position could be out.

tours.title: City of Shipbuilders
tours.subtitle: From the mudflats to the Titanic slipways

intro.title: The Lagan mudflats, 1840
intro.text: Before 1841 ships could reach the town quays only at high tide across shifting mudflats. Watch the channel being cut and an island rise from the spoil.

tours.title: The Belfast Blitz, 1941
tours.subtitle: Four raids in April and May 1941

intro.title: Spring 1941
intro.text: Belfast's war industries made it a target, yet the city had few shelters and little anti-aircraft cover. This tour visits documented sites, shown without graphic detail.

tours.title: Four Centuries of Growth
tours.subtitle: Watch the town become a city

intro.title: A charter town
intro.text: The growth envelope and building massing on this tour are a schematic model — they show the pattern of growth, not surveyed buildings.
